MIDTOWN NYC BRAZILIAN BLOWOUT SALON NYC

If you are looking for a Brazilian Blowout salon NYC but you are not sure where to find a Brazilian Blowout specialist, you can contact Luxe Aura Hair.

what is the difference between Brazilian Blowout & Keratin Treatment?

Brazilian blowout is a brand of frizz reducing products that smooths the hair out and almost fully eliminates frizz but it will not eliminate curls in the same way a Keratin Treatment does. Keratin treatment is made for softening curls on the hair and it will also smooth the hair out and make it silky and soft. both products will reduce blowdry time and fight frizz in humid weather. while keratin treatments cannot be washed out for 24-72 hours depending on the brand, brazilian blowout can be washed out immediately.

how long does Brazilian Blowout lasts?

The short answer is four to six (4-6) months however factors such as natural hair growth and overall maintenance can affect the life of your treatment. have a glossy, less frizzy and hydrated hair.

Our experienced hair stylists are the best Brazilian Blowout stylists in NYC and can guide you as to how the process works.

Will Brazilian Blowout work for me?

Our stylist team can also help you answer these questions as well however most hair types are ideal for brazilian blowout. it has been found that the brazilian blowout works the best on thicker, curly, and even kinkier hair types.

What exactly does a Brazilian Blowout do?

This is the best smoothing treatment in the world. If you have curly or frizzy hair or you just want to straighten out your lock, then this hair treatment process makes use of keratin as well as other chemical compounds to give you straight, no-frizz hair. 

How is Brazilian Blowout applied?

The process involves applying Brazilian Blowout lotion to your hair then smoothing through the hair with a flat iron. The lotion coats the hair creating a barrier that protects against frizzing or curling. How long does Brazilian Blowout take in a salon? This process could take as long as 90 minutes or more however the results make it worth it! The short answer is four to six (4-6) months however factors such as natural hair growth and overall maintenance can affect the life of your treatment. have a glossy, less frizzy and hydrated hair. This treatment also helps to protect your hair from external damages and also improves your hair condition. It does this by building up a protective protein layer just around the shafts of your hair to smooth the cuticles and remove frizz.

items.title: What is a Brazilian Blowout?
items.html: A Brazilian Blowout is a smoothing treatment that reduces frizz, adds shine, and makes hair more manageable using a protective protein layer.

items.title: What is the difference between Brazilian Blowout and keratin treatment?
items.html: Brazilian Blowout smooths hair and reduces frizz without fully removing curls, while keratin treatments soften curls more and require 24–72 hours before washing.

items.title: How long does a Brazilian Blowout last?
items.html: Results typically last 4 to 6 months, depending on hair type, growth, and maintenance.

items.title: Can I wash my hair after a Brazilian Blowout?
items.html: Yes, one major benefit is that you can wash your hair immediately after the treatment.

items.title: Is Brazilian Blowout suitable for all hair types?
items.html: Yes, it works best on thick, curly, frizzy, or kinky hair, but most hair types can benefit from it.

items.title: How long does a Brazilian Blowout appointment take?
items.html: The process usually takes about 90 minutes or more, depending on hair length and thickness.
